# Repeat 3 times but changing sample names
## 1M1: Short-term survival
## 5F1: Intermediate-term survival
## 2M1: Long-term survival

### 1. Install and load required packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# CRAN packages
cran_packages <- c("clipr", "stringr", "calibrate", "ggplot2", "gridExtra", "ggrepel")
for (pkg in cran_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Bioconductor packages
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}
bioc_packages <- c("edgeR", "limma", "locfit")
for (pkg in bioc_packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    BiocManager::install(pkg)
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Set the working directory
root <- "~/Documents/github/kidney-xenotransplantation-dbn-dde/preprocessing"
setwd(root)
getwd()
```

### Build the gene expression matrix

```{r}
# Load sample metadata
meta_data <- read.csv("./inputs/1M1.csv", header = TRUE)
sample_names <- as.character(meta_data[, 1])

# Read each sample's count file and collect expression values
expression_list <- list()
for (i in seq_along(sample_names)) {
  file_path <- file.path(root, "Samples/1M1", sample_names[i])
  temp <- read.table(file_path, sep = "", header = FALSE)
  if (i == 1) {
    gene_symbols <- as.character(temp[, 1])  # gene IDs from the first sample
  }
  expression_list[[i]] <- temp[, 2]  # expression values only
}

# Combine into one expression matrix
Expression <- as.data.frame(do.call(cbind, expression_list))
rownames(Expression) <- gene_symbols
colnames(Expression) <- sample_names

# Debug
head(Expression)
dim(Expression)
head(gene_symbols)
```

### Remove all-zero genes (mRNA data)

```{r}
nonzero_gene_idx <- rowSums(Expression) != 0
Expression <- Expression[nonzero_gene_idx, ]
gene_symbols <- gene_symbols[nonzero_gene_idx]
cat("Number of remaining genes:", nrow(Expression), "\n")

### 2. Define group information

# Group vector from metadata, Control as reference level
group <- as.factor(meta_data[, 2])
if ("Control" %in% levels(group)) {
  group <- relevel(group, ref = "Control")
}
print(table(group))

### 3. Create and filter the DGEList

dge <- DGEList(counts = Expression, group = group)

# Drop lowly expressed genes
keep <- filterByExpr(dge)
dge <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
dge <- DGEList(counts = dge$counts, group = group)  # rebuild after filtering

cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(dge$counts), "\n")
```

### TMM normalization

```{r}
# Compute normalization factors
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)
cat("Normalization factors:\n")
print(dge$samples$norm.factors)

# TMM-normalized CPM (raw and log-transformed)
cpm_tmm <- cpm(dge, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE, log = FALSE)
log_cpm_tmm <- cpm(dge, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE, log = TRUE)

# Save results
tmm_folder <- "./TMM_CSV/1M1/"
dir.create(tmm_folder, showWarnings = FALSE)
tmm_path <- file.path(tmm_folder, "short_TMM.csv")
log_tmm_path <- file.path(tmm_folder, "short_logTMM.csv")
write.csv(cpm_tmm, tmm_path, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
write.csv(log_cpm_tmm, log_tmm_path, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

### Convert Ensembl IDs to gene names and deduplicate

```{r}
# Read the annotation file
# Column 1: Ensembl gene ID, column 2: gene name/symbol
annotation_path <- file.path(root, "annotation/mac_ann.txt")
gene_annot <- read.csv(
  annotation_path,
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
head(gene_annot)
colnames(gene_annot)

annotation_map <- data.frame(
  EnsemblID = as.character(gene_annot[[1]]),
  GeneName  = as.character(gene_annot[[2]]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Strip version suffix, e.g. ENSMFAG00000048966.1 -> ENSMFAG00000048966
annotation_map$EnsemblID <- sub("\\..*$", "", annotation_map$EnsemblID)

# Keep only the first row per duplicated Ensembl ID
annotation_map <- annotation_map[!duplicated(annotation_map$EnsemblID), , drop = FALSE]

# Treat blank gene names as NA
annotation_map$GeneName <- trimws(annotation_map$GeneName)
annotation_map$GeneName[is.na(annotation_map$GeneName) | annotation_map$GeneName == ""] <- NA
```

### Match Ensembl IDs to gene-name symbols

```{r}
expression_ensembl_ids <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(cpm_tmm))

matched_gene_names <- annotation_map$GeneName[
  match(expression_ensembl_ids, annotation_map$EnsemblID)
]

cat("Total genes after filterByExpr:", length(expression_ensembl_ids), "\n")
cat("Successfully annotated genes:", sum(!is.na(matched_gene_names)), "\n")
cat("Unannotated genes:", sum(is.na(matched_gene_names)), "\n")
```

### Remove genes without an annotated name

```{r}
annotated_idx <- !is.na(matched_gene_names)
cpm_tmm_annotated <- cpm_tmm[annotated_idx, , drop = FALSE]
log_cpm_tmm_annotated <- log_cpm_tmm[annotated_idx, , drop = FALSE]
annotated_ensembl_ids <- expression_ensembl_ids[annotated_idx]
annotated_gene_names <- matched_gene_names[annotated_idx]
```

### Keep one row per duplicated gene-name symbol

```{r}
# When multiple Ensembl IDs map to the same gene name, keep the one
# with the highest max TMM CPM across samples
row_max_tmm <- apply(cpm_tmm_annotated, 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)

gene_info <- data.frame(
  RowIndex  = seq_len(nrow(cpm_tmm_annotated)),
  EnsemblID = annotated_ensembl_ids,
  GeneName  = annotated_gene_names,
  RowMaxTMM = row_max_tmm,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Sort by GeneName, then by descending RowMaxTMM within each gene
gene_info <- gene_info[
  order(gene_info$GeneName, -gene_info$RowMaxTMM, gene_info$EnsemblID),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

# Keep the first (highest RowMaxTMM) row per GeneName
gene_info_unique <- gene_info[!duplicated(gene_info$GeneName), , drop = FALSE]

cat("Duplicated gene-name rows removed:", nrow(gene_info) - nrow(gene_info_unique), "\n")
```

### Apply the selected rows to both matrices

```{r}
selected_rows <- gene_info_unique$RowIndex
cpm_tmm_gene <- cpm_tmm_annotated[selected_rows, , drop = FALSE]
log_cpm_tmm_gene <- log_cpm_tmm_annotated[selected_rows, , drop = FALSE]

# Use gene names (e.g. APOL6, DDX60) as row names instead of Ensembl IDs
rownames(cpm_tmm_gene) <- gene_info_unique$GeneName
rownames(log_cpm_tmm_gene) <- gene_info_unique$GeneName
```

### Sort gene names alphabetically

```{r}
alphabetical_order <- order(rownames(cpm_tmm_gene), na.last = TRUE)
cpm_tmm_gene <- cpm_tmm_gene[alphabetical_order, , drop = FALSE]
log_cpm_tmm_gene <- log_cpm_tmm_gene[alphabetical_order, , drop = FALSE]
```

### Save final results

```{r}
tmm_folder <- file.path(root, "TMM_CSV", "1M1")
dir.create(tmm_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tmm_path <- file.path(tmm_folder, "short_TMM_geneName.csv")
log_tmm_path <- file.path(tmm_folder, "short_logTMM_geneName.csv")

write.csv(cpm_tmm_gene, tmm_path, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
write.csv(log_cpm_tmm_gene, log_tmm_path, row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

### Final checks

```{r}
cat("Final number of unique annotated genes:", nrow(cpm_tmm_gene), "\n")
cat("Non-log TMM file:", tmm_path, "\n")
cat("Log TMM file:", log_tmm_path, "\n")

head(cpm_tmm_gene)
head(log_cpm_tmm_gene)
```
